caseName: Kansas City Southern Railway Co. v. Reily
caseNameFull: KANSAS CITY SOUTHERN RAILWAY CO. v. REILY, COLLECTOR OF REVENUE OF LOUISIANA
attorneys: W. Scott Wilkinson, Milton W. Schober and Pike Hall, Jr. for appellant., Emmett E. Batson for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. See National Leather Co. v. Massachusetts, 277 U. S. 413.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
